metadata.description: Mainmind — one connection for a whole space, whether it holds a company, a job hunt or anything else: every agent and every human on the same knowledge, the same rules, and the same judgment loop.

plugins.name: mainmind
plugins.description: Connect a Mainmind space: its knowledge at a named commit, the live run ledger, and the decision queue — via your personal OAuth invite code. Adds boot discipline, surface choice and the morning brief.
